claims.statement: 上下文是模型可用前文，本節固定視窗只保留最近幾字；沒有送入紅藍線索的相同輸入，在同一組參數下給相同候選分配，不能按缺失顏色穩定區分答案。五字使輸入可區分，並不保證已學會使用。
claims.scope: 本節明示的固定視窗前饋模型，輸入沒有外部狀態、顏色側資訊或每題參數切換。隨機採樣可偶然不同，但分配不能按未提供顏色改變；toy rule只是設定。

evidence.supports: Probability function g receives only the fixed sequence of feature vectors, with fixed shared parameters; equal provided contexts have the same output distribution. This supports the information-visibility condition, not success in learning.
Actual class is stateless embedding/flatten/linear/tanh/linear with no alternate color input; original class's duplicate rows yield equal logits in bounded check.

Contexts1/3/4 have equal input and zero max-logit difference; context5 differs by0.1511118 under one initialization. Setting hidden matrix/bias to zero intentionally ignores even visible color, illustrating visibility is insufficient.
Same suffix identifies no sample-specific color; the manually specified red-circle/blue-square rule is distinct from actual field benchmark corpus.
